items.prompt:
What does the underlined phrase really mean?

Mom said the messy garage was a piece of cake to clean once we all helped.

"A piece of cake" means
A) a slice of dessert
B) something very easy
C) something very hard
D) a birthday party

steps: "A piece of cake" is a figurative phrase.
It means something is very easy to do.
So the answer is B.

items.prompt:
Which sentence uses figurative language?

A) The dog ran across the yard.
B) The stars twinkled in the sky.
C) The wind sang a soft song through the trees.
D) The boy ate a red apple.
items.answer: C) The wind sang a soft song through the trees.

steps: Figurative language does not mean exactly what it says.
Wind cannot really sing a song, so that is figurative.
The answer is C.
solution.answer: C) The wind sang a soft song through the trees.

items.prompt:
Order from least cold to most cold. Which order is correct?

cool, chilly, freezing

A) freezing, chilly, cool
B) chilly, freezing, cool
C) cool, chilly, freezing
D) cool, freezing, chilly

steps: Cool is only a little cold.
Chilly is more cold than cool.
Freezing is the most cold, so C.

items.prompt:
Which of these words shows the LEAST sure feeling?

The detective ______ that the butler did it, but had no proof yet.

A) knew
B) proved
C) suspected
D) was certain

steps: The clue is "had no proof yet," so the detective is not sure.
"Knew," "proved," and "was certain" all mean fully sure.
"Suspected" means a small guess, the least sure, so C.

items.prompt:
What does the underlined phrase mean?

When I asked Ben to keep the surprise a secret, he said his lips were sealed.

"His lips were sealed" means
A) his lips were glued shut
B) he would not tell the secret
C) he was eating something sticky
D) he could not talk at all
items.answer: B) he would not tell the secret

steps: Ben's lips are not really glued.
The phrase is figurative and connects to keeping a secret.
It means he will not tell, so B.
solution.answer: B) he would not tell the secret

items.prompt:
Which word best completes the sentence to show the STRONGEST feeling?

After winning first place, Priya was not just glad, she was ______.

A) okay
B) fine
C) content
D) thrilled

steps: The sentence wants a feeling stronger than glad.
Okay, fine, and content are all mild or weaker.
"Thrilled" is the strongest happy feeling, so D.

items.prompt:
Read the sentence.

The test was a breeze, so Tara finished early and helped a friend.

Which statement is TRUE about "a breeze"?
A) It is literal, meaning wind blew through the room
B) It is figurative, meaning the test was very easy
C) It is literal, meaning the test was outside
D) It is figurative, meaning the test was very hard
items.answer: B) It is figurative, meaning the test was very easy

steps: There is no real wind in the sentence, so it is figurative.
The clue is that Tara "finished early."
"A breeze" means very easy, so B.
solution.answer: B) It is figurative, meaning the test was very easy

items.prompt:
Which list is correctly ordered from the SMALLEST amount of light to the MOST?

A) blazing, glowing, glimmering
B) glimmering, glowing, blazing
C) glowing, blazing, glimmering
D) blazing, glimmering, glowing

steps: All three words describe light.
"Glimmering" is a faint, small light.
"Glowing" is more light, and "blazing" is the brightest.
So the order is glimmering, glowing, blazing, B.
